title: Directors older than 75
statementMd:
List directors who were born in 1950 or earlier, with their age in 2024.

Expected columns: `name`, `age`.

Tables: `movies`, `directors`, `reviews`.

Row order does not matter.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT name, 2024 - birth_year AS age FROM directors WHERE birth_year <= 1950;
```

Compare with your own query; the result sets must match.
